metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the first ScenePattern data-model/registry slice before Maya host execution.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit 4dead02e67af985b6e7df19c7a42ad14b28f60c0 or later.
Compile aimayatool/tools/scene/patterns.py, smoke.py, and scene __init__.py.
No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from 5a17a4701de516fc3899907dd2269f201dbde092 to 255375819c7dea39672b260b514f8bea669e83de; py_compile passed for patterns.py, smoke.py, and scene __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove ScenePattern JSON round-trip, registry lookup/replacement/removal, and duplicate rejection in Maya 2024.
acceptance: Run aimayatool.tools.scene.smoke.run_scene_pattern_smoke in Maya 2024.
Verify ScenePattern JSON round-trip and registry behavior.
Return SCENE_PATTERN_SMOKE_OK.
metadata.diagnosis: Fresh-spawn Maya 2024 timed out after 180 seconds with empty output and no success/error marker. Deterministic Scene verification passed, so there is no product-failure evidence. Owner approved managed live-Maya validation that reuses a ready session or launches one automatically, forces a new unsaved scene per test, and leaves Maya running.
metadata.evidence: maya:ui_smoke timed out after 180s; Maya path C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Maya2024\bin\maya.exe; output was empty.

metadata.purpose: Synchronize and deterministically verify managed Maya live-session lifecycle before restarting AIBrigde.
acceptance: Fast-forward D:/AIBrigde main to include commit 2e91a96ec21b8e901608360711d380f481e604ad or later.
Compile maya_live_session.py, maya_managed_live_smoke_capability.py, python_verification_capability.py, and the focused live-session tests.
Run tests.test_maya_live_smoke_capability.
Prove each test forces cmds.file(new=True, force=True), never saves or quits Maya, reuses a ready session, and supports automatic managed Maya launch when no live session is ready.
metadata.evidence: D:/AIBrigde was already at 2e91a96ec21b8e901608360711d380f481e604ad. py_compile passed for maya_live_session.py, maya_managed_live_smoke_capability.py, python_verification_capability.py, and test_maya_live_smoke_capability.py; both live-session imports passed; focused unittest ran 5 tests in 0.004s and returned OK.

metadata.purpose: Restart the managed AIBrigde worker so maya:managed_live_smoke is loaded from verified runtime code.
acceptance: Request the normal managed Bridge restart only after deterministic verification passes.
Do not execute the Maya retry on stale pre-change worker code.

metadata.purpose: Retry ScenePattern functional validation through the managed Maya live session.
acceptance: Reuse the ready managed Maya 2024 session when available; otherwise automatically launch Maya 2024 and bootstrap the private localhost live channel.
Before the test, force cmds.file(new=True, force=True), discarding the currently open scene without saving it.
Never save the test scene and never quit Maya after validation.
Run aimayatool.tools.scene.smoke.run_scene_pattern_smoke and return SCENE_PATTERN_SMOKE_OK.

metadata.purpose: Verify the ScenePattern model/registry UI composition does not break AIMayaTool launch using the managed Maya session.
acceptance: Reuse the same managed Maya session when healthy; automatically recover by launching Maya if no live session is available.
Before validation, force a new scene without saving the currently open scene.
Verify bootstrap.install_and_launch creates AIMayaToolWindow after ScenePattern UI composition.
Do not save or quit Maya after validation.
